== Biography ==

The Duchess is a noblewoman marked by a fierce temperament. The White Rabbit, seemingly in her service, grows anxious at the thought of keeping her waiting, for she is renowned for her savage nature. When Alice encountered her in a kitchen, the Duchess proved sharp-tempered, though Alice later wondered whether the pepper in that room might have accounted for such severity. According to Alice, the Duchess also displayed a more amiable disposition in other moments and frequently sought moral lessons in everyday things. She now faces sentence of execution by the Queen and has fled to escape this fate.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. The Queen threatens the Duchess with execution.

'''[[White Rabbit]]''' — employment. The Rabbit appears to serve the Duchess, hurrying to meet her and fearing her displeasure if kept waiting.

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The two meet in the kitchen, where the Duchess displays both fierce and pleasant temperament in Alice's account.

''Evolution:''
* [[Queen]] — Enemy (ch.6→ch.9)<ref>Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chapter 6</ref>
